chunks: There are some who listen to you; but as soon as they go from you they say to those who were given knowledge: 'What is this he is saying now?' They are those whose hearts have been sealed by God, and they follow their own lusts.

key_terms.أَهْوَاءَهُمْ: their own lusts or subjective desires

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God says He has sealed the hearts of those who follow their own lusts?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the distinction between mere auditory reception and true intellectual acceptance, where the 'people of knowledge' (Ahl al-'Ilm) serve as the interpretive key to the Imam's teachings. The 'sealing of hearts' is understood not as a divine decree of predestination, but as a consequence of their voluntary adherence to subjective whims (ahwa'), which dulls their spiritual perception. This underscores the Shia emphasis on the necessity of aligning one's inner disposition with the objective truth of the Ahl al-Bayt to avoid spiritual stagnation.
